==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) There is a door inside Leon that leads to many different worlds that can be opened on both sides. I destroyed a robot drone that tried to steal the Reality Warping Stone that came through this door. The drone's owner tried to make a deal with me for the stone, but I refused and kicked him out. (The drone's owner was a man with a low buzz cut, practically bald, brown skin, charming face, and wore green and purple regal robes. He seemed like some kind of roboticist or technopath.)
